answer: One concrete defense is a refundable stake locked per identity: like quartz forming only under sustained pressure, an account must hold funds through a waiting period while its work is observed. Each new identity faces the same rising tide of cost, so an attacker spinning up thousands of sock puppets must park umber-dark capital behind every one, capital that cannot be reused elsewhere and is slashed on misbehavior, making the attack cost far more than any reward it could extract.
